scenes.title: Up on the Balcony
scenes.summary: On Friday morning, Matvey, Roman, and Kira step onto the sunny second-floor courtyard balcony and test the original iron hooks made for festival lantern cords.

scenes.title: Stringing Gold Above the Tree
scenes.summary: Roman and Gleb stretch warm gold-and-coral lantern cords from the upper balcony to the courtyard shade tree while Zoya directs the symmetry from below.

scenes.title: The Master Seating Chart
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Yaroslav proudly shows Kira and Larisa his enormous hand-lettered seating poster for twenty-eight guests and refuses to make a backup copy.

scenes.title: A Sudden Gust of Wind
scenes.summary: Stepping into the courtyard, a sudden wind gust tangles the overhead lanterns and launches Yaroslav's giant seating chart straight across the stones.

scenes.title: Floating in the Basin
scenes.summary: Lifting the soaked poster out of the stone basin, Yaroslav despairs over the blurred blue cloud while Matvey and Zoya talk him back from panic.

scenes.title: Untangling the Lantern Cord
scenes.summary: Back on the upper balcony, Matvey and Roman reel in the twisted lantern lines and add wooden spacer loops so the globes stay steady in any breeze.

scenes.title: Twenty-Eight Wooden Clothespins
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Matvey pours out sturdy birch clothespins, and Kira numbers them one to twenty-eight in bold pencil to clip onto heavy cloth napkins.

scenes.title: Windproof and Ready
scenes.summary: Just before noon on Saturday, Kira, Zoya, and Roman admire the windproof rooftop lanterns and clipped linen tables—all set for six this evening, until the front-desk telephone rings!
